subject: Invoice format, payment route (PO vs card) & next steps for pilot
messages:
From: Marta Gonzalez <marta@greenbyte.ai>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Jared Cole <jared.cole@greenbyte.ai>, procurement@greenbyte.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot commercial path + billing questions

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the demo today. Jared and I would like to move to a 6-week pilot but need to confirm how billing will work on our side so we can loop in procurement. A few quick questions:

- Do you accept POs or do you prefer card/marketplace purchases for pilots?
- If PO: what invoice fields do you require (VAT/tax line, billing address format, company registration)?
- If card or AWS Marketplace: any differences in invoicing or taxes we should expect?
- Are net terms available for pilots or only for committed Dedicated contracts?

We can provide standard GreenByte PO templates if that helps. Also attaching our procurement checklist — happy to jump on a quick call with your billing ops if needed.

Best,
Marta
Head of Product Operations
GreenByte Analytics

Attachment: GB_Procurement_Checklist.pdf
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Marta Gonzalez <marta@greenbyte.ai>, Jared Cole <jared.cole@greenbyte.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial path + billing questions

Thanks Marta — great to hear you want to move forward. Quick answers up-front, then proposed next steps: 

- PO vs card/marketplace: We support all three. For pilots we commonly accept company card (fastest), signed SOW + card, or PO routed through RedWood Finance. AWS Marketplace is supported but that adds ~3–5 business days for marketplace reconciliation and vendor onboarding.
- Invoice fields: If you’re issuing a PO, we need billing name, billing address, VAT/Tax ID (if applicable), and a PO number. Our standard invoice includes a VAT line item when a VAT ID is provided.
- Net terms: Typically net-30 for customers on an enterprise contract. For small pilots we can do card or pre-pay to avoid extending credit; net terms for pilots require finance approval (and a short credit check).
- If using Marketplace: invoice will be issued by the marketplace (AWS) and tax handling follows their marketplace rules; Redwood will provide a usage statement to attach to your billing.

Next steps I propose:
1) You share the PO template you mentioned and the billing address/VAT details.
2) Aditya (cc’d) will share our InvoiceSpec_Template.xlsx so your billing team can map fields.
3) If you prefer PO + net terms for the pilot, we can get finance involved — please indicate the decision and I’ll introduce our Billing Ops lead.

Can we do a 20-minute call tomorrow to align with procurement? I’m available 09:30–11:30 PT.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
From: aditya_rao@redwood.com
To: procurement@greenbyte.ai, Marta Gonzalez <marta@greenbyte.ai>, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:21:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice spec + sample fields (GreenByte pilot)

Hi Marta / procurement team —

Adding the invoice spec I mentioned. The attached InvoiceSpec_Template.xlsx includes the exact field names we emit on PDF invoices and in CSV/EDI exports. Key fields you’ll likely map:

- invoice_number
- invoice_date
- po_number (optional but required to match a PO)
- billing_company_name
- billing_address_line1
- billing_address_line2
- billing_city
- billing_state
- billing_postal_code
- country
- vat_id
- line_item_description (model name, usage period)
- quantity / unit_price / total
- tax_amount / tax_rate
- total_due

If GreenByte requires a different layout we can support custom formatting for purchase orders > $50k or for customers onboarding to Dedicated. For the 6-week pilot we can accept a PO with a PO number and process net-30 upon finance approval, or you can use a company card for immediate start.

Also: if you plan to go via AWS Marketplace, flag that now so we can align contract signatures — the timeline is longer there.

Grace — if you can share a short note about typical finance SLA for approving pilot net terms at our size, that will help Marta’s procurement team.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: InvoiceSpec_Template.xlsx
From: Marta Gonzalez <marta@greenbyte.ai>

Next: Hannah — please introduce your Billing Ops lead so we can get vendor setup and confirm the invoice format. If finance requires additional credit info, let us know what you need and we’ll push it internally.

Best,
Marta
